description: This Java class implements a Git synchronization service for the Thingsboard platform, managing repository cloning, fetching, and update notifications.

classes.name: DefaultGitSyncService
classes.description: A service class that manages synchronization with Git repositories, including cloning, fetching, and notifying updates.

methods.name: registerSync
methods.description: Registers a repository for synchronization, setting up periodic fetches and update callbacks.

methods.name: listFiles
methods.description: Lists files at a specific commit in the repository, filtered by type and depth.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a specific file at the last known commit.

methods.name: getGithubRawContentUrl
methods.description: Constructs a raw URL for a file in a GitHub repository.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Retrieves or reinitializes a GitRepository instance for a given key.

methods.name: initRepository
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes a GitRepository based on provided settings.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Handles repository update events, resolving the latest commit and invoking update listeners.

methods.name: getRepoDirectory
methods.description: Determines the local directory path for a repository based on its URI.

methods.name: getLastCommit
methods.description: Returns the last resolved commit for a repository key.

methods.name: getBranchRef
methods.description: Constructs the branch reference string for a repository.

methods.name: preDestroy
methods.description: Shuts down the executor service during bean destruction.
